From late-night rituals to whispered deals with Lucifer, she exposes the hidden side of the entertainment industry — the part no one wants to talk about.

As millions are watching the rise of pop culture idols and new music releases — from Hollywood stars to Taylor Swift’s latest album, 'The Life of a Showgirl' — few realize the spiritual battles happening behind the scenes. This story pulls back the curtain on the occult connections between fame, fortune, and dark spiritual forces.
